title: 带着你的痛点横着看
prompt:
# Codex PPT Slide Image Prompt

## Canvas
{
  "type": "16:9 full-slide PowerPoint image",
  "language": "Chinese",
  "slide_number": 4,
  "render_slide_number": true
}

## Deck Goal
向外部开发者介绍 Flow2Spec:一个让 AI 编码工具跨会话保持项目上下文的 Spec-driven 工作流层。用真实生产数据证明价值,并诚实说明边界。

## Required Background
{
  "deck_context": {
    "source_summary": "Flow2Spec 在项目里建立小而可路由的 .Knowledge/ 知识库(manifest 路由 + matchers 匹配词表 + topics 主题分片 + stock/req 文档),安装 f2s-* 技能,把任务状态(.task/)与产品知识分开。新会话按需求加载相关事实,而不是重新翻整个仓库。已在 4 个真实生产仓运行:主仓 A(前端主仓 3 年,1012 核心文件 12.9 万行,43 topic,27 位作者)、接口项目 B(Serverless,213 文件,25 topic)、B 端项目 C(73 文件,20 topic)、C 端项目 D(28 文件,15 topic)。",
    "core_claim": "不是让 AI 更聪明,是让 AI 一直知道你在做什么——上下文变准,而不是模型变强。",
    "canonical_terms": [
      "Memory Coding(记忆编码进可提交的仓库,可 diff 可协作)",
      ".Knowledge/(知识环)",
      ".task/(任务环)",
      "manifest → matcher → topic 路由链",
      "match → expand → verify → act 四步",
      "f2s-kb-feat / f2s-kb-fix / f2s-git-commit / f2s-kb-sync / f2s-kb-add / f2s-kb-distill",
      "topic / 终稿 / 代码 三层递进",
      "intentRecognition 意图识别"
    ]
  },
  "slide_local_context": {
    "required_background": "画一个简化对比矩阵表格:左列 6 行痛点短语,顶行 5 家对手名 + 最右 Flow2Spec 高亮列(青色底纹)。格子里用极简短语(每格 3-8 字)示意「会发生什么」,对手列偏灰,F 列偏亮。表格下方一条琥珀色「短板自曝」横条:不同步知识库 · 仍会腐化。不需要还原全部细节文字,保持表格可读即可。"
  }
}

## Global Style
{
  "name": "赛博终端风(cyberpunk terminal UI)",
  "visual_direction": "高级开发者工具界面感:极深蓝黑背景(约 #0a0e1a),细微网格纹理与极淡水平扫描线,左上角仿终端窗口三个小圆点装饰,卡片为深色半透明底 + 细霓虹描边 + 圆角",
  "color_palette": "主强调霓虹青色 #5ef1ff(标题发光),次强调霓虹品红 #ff78d6,辅助紫色与琥珀色用于区分并列卡片,正文白色/浅灰",
  "typography": "大标题粗壮无衬线,关键词青色发光;代码与标签用等宽字体;中文正文现代无衬线;信息层级清晰,大量呼吸留白",
  "texture_and_finish": "扁平 UI 平面设计,霓虹辉光,无照片素材",
  "deck_consistency": "全 16 页同一配色/字体/描边卡片语言/终端装饰;按页面角色变化版式,不重复同一构图"
}

## Input Images

- Image 1: /Users/temptrip/Desktop/项目/double coding/Flow2Spec/presentations/flow2spec-intro-pptx/origin_image/slide_06.png — approved sample slide style reference; match style only; do not copy layout or content


## Slide
{
  "number": 4,
  "title": "带着你的痛点横着看",
  "role": "comparison matrix",
  "intent": "竞品对比:6 个真实痛点 × 5 类方案 + Flow2Spec,诚实含自曝短板"
}

## Text
{
  "title": "带着你的痛点横着看",
  "key_points": [
    "六个痛点:spec 追得上代码? / 大仓要读多少? / 分层·精读? / 换 IDE·模型? / 会话续作? / 可 diff·review?",
    "五类对手:OpenSpec · Superpowers 类技能包 · RAG 向量库 · Spec Kit 类 · Claude Memory",
    "Flow2Spec 列:kb-feat/fix 改代码带改知识库 + kb-sync 随时手动全量补 + kb-add 模块入库;matcher+依赖链每次几百行;topic/终稿/代码三层递进;各客户端原生加载(含 DeepSeek Harness);.task/ 关键词续作;.Knowledge/ 全落盘可 review",
    "自曝短板:不同步知识库 · 仍会腐化——工具不能替代纪律"
  ],
  "speaker_focus": null
}

## Layout
{
  "composition": "全宽 7 列对比矩阵 + 底部短板横条",
  "relationship_to_previous_slide": "new layout"
}

## Visual Elements
{
  "main_visual": "矩阵表格,最右列霓虹青高亮",
  "supporting_elements": "琥珀色警示条"
}

## Constraints
[
  "表格文字宁少勿糊,每格短语必须清晰",
  "页码渲染为 04 / 16 放右下角"
]

## Style Reference Rule
Use Image 1 as the approved sample-slide style reference. Match its palette, typography mood, density, texture, and overall visual identity. Do not copy its exact layout unless this slide's layout explicitly asks for it.

## Input Image Handling Rules
For any input image marked as a strict input asset, include it visibly and preserve its content. Do not redraw, replace, relabel, or invent a similar figure. Scale and crop only as needed for composition while keeping the important labels, arrows, data, and relationships recognizable.

## Universal Constraints
- The final image itself must contain the title and key points.
- Render Chinese text exactly and legibly; avoid garbled characters.
- Keep the confirmed deck style consistent while varying layout by slide role.
- No watermark or unrelated logo. Render the page number exactly as specified in Constraints (bottom-right, e.g. 03 / 16), matching the approved sample's footer.

input_images.fidelity: match style only; do not copy layout or content

sample_generation_method.prompt_source: prompts/slide_XX.json 的 prompt 字段(样张来自 prompts/sample_slide_06_prompt.txt)
sample_generation_method.model: gpt-image-2.5-flare via Peta gateway (OPENAI_BASE_URL + CODEX_PPT_COOKIE in ~/.codex-ppt-skill/.env)
sample_generation_method.input_context_preparation: CLI fallback 模式,风格参考通过 prompt 文字描述传递(Peta generations 接口不带输入图),各 job 的 prompt 已内嵌完整风格系统
sample_generation_method.handoff_rule: Subagents must use scripts/image_gen.py with the same model/size/quality via the runtime venv; return a blocker if unavailable.
